title: First Successful Release: Zoo returns 62 young snakes to wild; another release planned for 2027
summary_full: In a remarkable conservation effort, 62 San Francisco garter snakes, previously raised in a zoo, have been successfully released into their natural environment. This project stems from the need to ensure the species’ survival, as they were originally taken from the wild. Alongside this, restoration activities are being implemented to enhance their habitat.
